moments.text: Infrared sensor view of grey cloud layers with a crosshair, corner brackets and black redaction boxes; a small dark spot sits below-left of the crosshair.
Close-up view: a small dark object with a faint trail enters at the right edge and crosses right to left, leaving the left edge in about 1.2 s.
Wide view of a mottled cloud field; a tiny dark dot drifts just above the crosshair.
Close-up again: a dark oval object appears right of centre and crosses right to left, leaving the left edge after about 1.4 s.
Hazy grey view: a tiny dark dot drifts from the upper right toward the centre; after a zoom-in at 74.7 s it keeps closing on the crosshair.
A dark object with bright horizontal streaks on both sides appears at the top edge, slides right, then drops toward the upper-right corner bracket.
The view zooms out: the object is now a tiny dark dot just above the crosshair, fading out by about 100 s.
A small black redaction square appears near the crosshair and moves around the empty grey view for almost a minute.
Close-up: a row of three small dark dots appears below-left of the crosshair and rises to just above it.
After a white flash, four dark spots in a row sit above-left of the crosshair, then slide down beside it.
A different view: a dark rectangular patch with several dark blobs along its lower edge fills the lower half of the picture.
Wide view of streaky clouds: a dark diffuse patch drifts from the right onto the crosshair; a close-up from 263.3 s shows a small dark spot below-left.
A dark round spot with a dark halo sits in bright cloud below the crosshair; small dark specks scatter to its left.
The picture turns flat blue-grey for about 4 s, then the dark ringed spot returns lower right; streaky clouds end the clip.

notes: Official description says 02:06-03:42 'No content', but the footage continues (empty sky, a moving redaction square, near-full-screen redaction 3:00-3:04).
